description.value: Nasa Bakery & Café is an authentic Turkish bakery and café on Commercial Drive, founded by Naci Saklica, a master baker with over two decades of experience running a café in Istanbul. The menu spans traditional pastries like simit, börek, and baklava alongside Turkish coffee, ayran, and şalgam, all made from scratch using traditional techniques. Situated steps from the Commercial–Broadway SkyTrain station in the heart of The Drive, it is a natural fuelling stop for cyclists exploring East Vancouver.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 27m; stands (3 spaces) at 65m; rack at 74m; wall_loops (3 spaces) at 77m. Total: 8 spaces.
